content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the case involved an applicant and defendant 2 both parties were ordered to pay €52360 in legal fees the court decided to divide a land plot and building equally between the applicant and defendant 2 the legal text discusses two articles in the civil code related to matrimonial property the claimant filed for the dissolution of marriage division of property and compensation for damages the defendant partially agreed but rejected the claim for damages third parties opposed the division of property the applicant later amended the claim to reduce their share and increase the defendants share the court considered the value of the property and the interests of creditors the court concluded that the unequal division was justified due to the applicants fault in the dissolution of the marriage and the funding of the property by the applicants parents the court confirmed the division as agreed upon the parties were exempted from stamp duty and the defendant was ordered to pay the applicants share of the costs either party can apply for a modification in the agreement in case of a material change in circumstances

civil_codes_used: Art. 3.117 Shares in the matrimonial property
Art. 3.123 Deviation from equal shares of the spouses' community property
